# [Baseline] - MAC - D - Time Server

Has the Mac synchronise its clock with time.apple.com, so that timestamps in logs, Kerberos tickets and certificate checks are correct.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | macOS |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | All Devices |
| checkId | `INTUNE-BASE-201-MACDTimeServer` |
| Source | CIS Apple macOS 26.0 Tahoe Benchmark v1.1.0 L1 2.3.2.1 (mSCP branch tahoe, ODV time.apple.com); form taken from microsoft/intune-my-macs pol-sys-100-ntp |
| File | [`Baseline_MAC_D_Time_Server.json`](Baseline_MAC_D_Time_Server.json) |

> The second part of CIS 2.3.2.1, enforcing 'set time automatically' (com.apple.timed TMAutomaticTimeOnlyEnabled), is not in the settings catalog; the macOS default is already on. Time zone (com.apple.mcx timeZone) deliberately not set: an organisation with people in several time zones would then show the wrong time. Phase 1: should get a rule in _assignments.json (allDevicesAssignmentTarget), like the other MAC - D policies in phase 1.
